title: fix(metadata): history snapshots no longer store the keys a connector save drains
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XJGqAZH1VXaPVicsfiY7fkh)_

Refs #29484 (step (c) of ruling 6677709817 only; the card stays open for step (b), the read-only count and the scrub.)

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — Ruling-ref 6677709817: what a history row stores narrows; nothing a door accepts or serves changes.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`sys_metadata_history` 新写入的快照,不再保存连接器上「保存时会被清掉」的那些键(未声明的 `auth` 键,以及对象型 `retryConfig` 里的未声明键)。两个历史写入点(协议层 `SysMetadataRepository.put`,以及旧的 `DatabaseLoader`)都改走同一个函数 `historySnapshotBody`。
- 为什么改:#28640 ②B 让「读出再保存」把这些键从活行里清掉,但历史快照是同一份内容的第二份落盘副本。实测回滚到旧版本时,新写的 `revert` 历史行会把该键原样带回来;不经过保存门的写入也一样。裁决 6677709817 选 (c):从现在起新历史行不再带它。
- 风险与回滚:只改历史行的 `metadata` 列;其它类型(以及没有此类键的连接器)快照与原来逐字节相同,有 CONTROL 用例钉住。历史行的 `checksum` 仍是活行的指纹,读历史的出口不变。已有历史行不动,留给 (b)。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/metadata/src/utils/history-snapshot-body.ts`(删哪些位置完全由类型 redactor 的 `notCarriedForwardKeys` 决定,没有第二份名单);`packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts` 的历史 insert 一处;`packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` 的 `createHistoryRecord`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/sys-metadata-repository.history-snapshot-drained-keys.test.ts`,预期 5/5 通过,其中「回滚到旧快照」一条证明新 revert 行不含该键。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **One helper decides what a history snapshot stores**: `historySnapshotBody(type, body)` in `@objectstack/metadata`, published as the leaf subpath `@objectstack/metadata/history-snapshot` (its own tsup entry, for the reason `@objectstack/metadata/errors` has one: the protocol needs the function, not the manager and loaders).
  - It asks the type's read-path redactor (`getMetadataTypeRedactor`, `@objectstack/spec/kernel`) for `notCarriedForwardKeys` on this body and removes exactly those positions from a copy. That is the same answer the save door's carry-forward drains by (`planCarryForward` in `metadata-redaction.ts`), so there is one predicate, not a second list. The helper names no key and no type.
  - A body with no such position comes back **by reference**, so every other type's snapshot is the body written, byte for byte.
  - A dotted key name (`auth['legacy.token']`) is resolved the way the carry-forward resolves it: every dot a separator first, then longer trailing keys.
  - After removing, it asks the redactor again. If a named position is still there, it throws instead of writing that snapshot (a shape it does not understand must not pass silently).
- **Both `sys_metadata_history` writers call it**:
  - `SysMetadataRepository.put` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`): the history writer behind the `/meta` save door, publish (`promoteDraft`) and revert (`restoreVersion`, used by `rollbackMetaItem` and commit revert). A throw fails the write, inside the same transaction.
  - `DatabaseLoader.createHistoryRecord` (`@objectstack/metadata`): its posture for every history failure is kept: the snapshot is skipped and logged, and the metadata write itself succeeds.
- **Unchanged**: the live `sys_metadata` row each writer stores, the history row's `checksum` (still the live row's stamp, its documented meaning), and the history read exit `redactStoredMetadataRow(s)`.

### Mechanism measured (the order's hypotheses)

- Hypothesis "the history writer lives in `packages/metadata`": **partly falsified**. There are two writers. The one every runtime save, publish and revert goes through is `SysMetadataRepository.put` in `packages/metadata-protocol`; `DatabaseLoader` (MetadataManager's platform-global loader) is the second. The seat amended the claim surface for the first (amendment 6710598621).
- Hypothesis "the snapshot is written before the drain runs": **falsified for the save door**. The door drains the body before `repo.put`, and `put` writes the same body to the live row and to history, so a save of the served form already wrote a drained snapshot (code reading of `protocol-save.ts` → `repo.put`). The new rows that still carried the key came from bodies no door re-judged: **a revert to a snapshot written before the drain** (measured: the new `revert` row held it; pinned below), a publish of an older draft, a direct `put`, and `DatabaseLoader` writes.
- The **whole** not-carried-forward set is withheld, per the seat's answer: the connector's undeclared `auth` keys (ruling 6566912252, #28640 ②B) and the undeclared keys of an object `retryConfig` (ruling 6593804783). The rule is "a snapshot never carries a key the save drains". The contract review judges this reading.

## Tests

New, all three files:

- `packages/metadata/src/utils/history-snapshot-body.test.ts` (8): drops exactly what the connector redactor names (the test first pins that the redactor names `auth.token`, so the drop is the shared answer); plural spelling; dotted key name; cleared value; `retryConfig` key; input not mutated. CONTROLs: a declared credential map (carried forward, not drained) comes back by reference; `object` and `datasource` come back by reference; non-object bodies pass through.
- `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader-history-snapshot-withholds-drained-keys.test.ts` (5, real SQLite through `driver-sqlite-wasm`): `create`, `update` and `revert` snapshots hold no undeclared `auth` key. CONTROLs: every declared position kept exactly; a non-connector snapshot and a connector with nothing undeclared are byte-identical to `JSON.stringify(body)`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.history-snapshot-drained-keys.test.ts` (5): a `put` writes a snapshot without the key; **a revert to a version-1 snapshot that still holds the key appends a `revert` snapshot without it**. Same three CONTROLs.

- `packages/metadata/src/serializers/typescript-serializer-annotation.test.ts`: the export-entry count pin moves 7 → 8 for the new `./history-snapshot` entry (the pin exists so that a new entry moves it).
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`: the new repository fake is recorded by `node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write` (the gate's own remedy; 0 seams lost).

## Verification

All readings below are on head `23391a14` unless a line says otherwise.

<details><summary>Ablation (the first pin of each writer): red with the call removed, green restored</summary>

Both through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit once, blob moved, restore proved `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty). The suites import the writer from `src/`, so no rebuild sits between mutation and run.

- `DatabaseLoader.createHistoryRecord`: `historySnapshotBody(type, metadata)` → `metadata`. The loader file went **3 failed | 2 passed (5)**: the `create`, CONTROL-declared and `update`/`revert` pins red with `expected '{"name":"vendor_api",…' not to contain 'TEST_PLACEHOLDER_LEGACY_AUTH_VALUE'`; the two byte-identical CONTROLs stayed green.
- `SysMetadataRepository.put`: `historySnapshotBody(ref.type, body)` → `body`. The repository file went **3 failed | 2 passed (5)**: the `put`, CONTROL-declared and revert pins red the same way; the two byte-identical CONTROLs stayed green.

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata test`: Test Files 70 passed (70), Tests 971 passed (971) (head `23391a14`); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata run typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 322 passed | 4 skipped (326), Tests 22530 passed | 26 skipped (22556) (after the merge of `origin/main`; later commits touch only this card's test file and a ledger); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol run typecheck`: exit 0 on `818912eb`.
- Full dogfood battery (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm), `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'` then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, on `818912eb`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 435 passed | 3 skipped (438), Tests 3609 passed | 41 skipped (3650). The one later commit edits a `@objectstack/metadata` unit test only.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 83 families on this diff, every one run and exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 83 derived, 83 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Run on `23391a14` after the last commit (the record is `pm-orders/server/29484-gates-ran.txt` in the project files). Plus `eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata packages/metadata-protocol`: exit 0. The first loop found two reds in this card's own repository fake (`check:engine-double-contract`: ledger did not record it; `check:objectql-double-limit`: its `find` ignored `limit`); both fixed in `818912eb` and green since.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- One out-of-scope finding about the live row (not history) went to the seat privately, per the card's rule on stored-secret specifics; nothing of it is fixed here.
- Existing history rows are not touched: that is step (b), a read-only count first, then a scrub after the maintainer confirms the count.
- No `packages/spec/**` file changes.
